question: Group spaces in the Stata building by the access level and usage type. For each group, state the access level, usage type, name of the space, the number of spaces, total area across all rooms in the space, and average area across all rooms in the space. Display the access level only if it differs from the previous entry. Include subtotals for each access level, usage type, and space name, subtotals for each access level, and a grand total across all access levels. Exclude usage type that includes "STORAGE". All numerical values should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_with_building" AS SELECT 
  r.building_key AS building_key,
  r.floor AS floor,
  r.room AS room,
  r.space_id AS space_id,
  r.area AS area,
  r.access_level AS access_level,
  r.use_desc AS use_desc,
  r.room_full_name AS room_full_name,
  b.building_name_long AS building_name_long,
  b.building_number AS building_number
FROM beaver."fac_rooms" r
JOIN beaver."fac_building" b
  ON r.building_key = b.fac_building_key

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        r.access_level,
        r.use_desc,
        COALESCE(r.space_id, r.room_full_name, r.room) AS space_name,
        r.area
    FROM rooms_with_building r
    WHERE r.building_name_long ILIKE '%stata%'
      AND (r.use_desc IS NULL OR r.use_desc NOT ILIKE '%storage%')
), agg AS (
    SELECT 
        access_level,
        use_desc,
        space_name,
        COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
        SUM(area) AS total_area,
        AVG(area) AS avg_area,
        GROUPING(access_level) AS g_access,
        GROUPING(use_desc) AS g_use,
        GROUPING(space_name) AS g_space
    FROM base
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
        (access_level, use_desc, space_name),
        (access_level, use_desc),
        (access_level),
        ()
    )
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN g_access = 0 THEN CAST(access_level AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS access_level,
    CASE WHEN g_use = 0 THEN use_desc ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 0 AND g_use = 1 AND g_space = 1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level)' ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 0 AND g_use = 1 AND g_space = 0 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level, Space Name)' ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 0 AND g_use = 0 AND g_space = 1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level, Usage Type)' ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 1 AND g_use = 1 AND g_space = 1 THEN 'Grand Total' ELSE use_desc END END END END AS usage_type,
    CASE WHEN g_space = 0 THEN space_name ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 0 AND g_use = 0 AND g_space = 1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level, Usage Type)' ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 0 AND g_use = 1 AND g_space = 1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level)' ELSE CASE WHEN g_access = 1 AND g_use = 1 AND g_space = 1 THEN 'Grand Total' ELSE space_name END END END END AS space_name,
    printf('%d', CAST(ROUND(num_spaces) AS BIGINT)) AS number_of_spaces,
    printf('%d', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area_sqft,
    printf('%d', CAST(ROUND(avg_area) AS BIGINT)) AS average_area_sqft
FROM agg
ORDER BY 
    g_access, access_level NULLS LAST,
    g_use, use_desc NULLS LAST,
    g_space, space_name NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    r.access_level,
    r.use_desc,
    COALESCE(r.space_id, r.room_full_name, r.room) AS space_name,
    r.area
  FROM rooms_with_building r
  WHERE (
    r.building_name_long ILIKE '%stata%'
    OR r.building_number = '32'
  )
    AND (r.use_desc IS NULL OR r.use_desc NOT ILIKE '%storage%')
), agg AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    GROUPING(access_level) AS g_access,
    GROUPING(use_desc) AS g_use,
    GROUPING(space_name) AS g_space
  FROM base
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS (
    (access_level, use_desc, space_name),
    (access_level, use_desc),
    (access_level),
    ()
  )
), labeled AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN g_access = 0 THEN CAST(access_level AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS access_level_disp,
    CASE 
      WHEN g_access=1 AND g_use=1 AND g_space=1 THEN 'Grand Total'
      WHEN g_access=0 AND g_use=1 AND g_space=1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level)'
      WHEN g_access=0 AND g_use=0 AND g_space=1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level, Usage Type)'
      WHEN g_access=0 AND g_use=1 AND g_space=0 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level, Space Name)'
      ELSE COALESCE(use_desc,'')
    END AS usage_type_disp,
    CASE 
      WHEN g_access=1 AND g_use=1 AND g_space=1 THEN 'Grand Total'
      WHEN g_access=0 AND g_use=0 AND g_space=1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level, Usage Type)'
      WHEN g_access=0 AND g_use=1 AND g_space=1 THEN 'Subtotal (Access Level)'
      ELSE COALESCE(space_name,'')
    END AS space_name_disp,
    num_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    g_access, g_use, g_space,
    access_level, use_desc, space_name
  FROM agg
)
SELECT 
  access_level_disp AS access_level,
  usage_type_disp AS usage_type,
  space_name_disp AS space_name,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(num_spaces) AS BIGINT)) AS number_of_spaces,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area_sqft,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(avg_area) AS BIGINT)) AS average_area_sqft
FROM labeled
ORDER BY 
  g_access, access_level NULLS LAST,
  g_use, use_desc NULLS LAST,
  g_space, space_name NULLS LAST;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    r.access_level,
    r.use_desc,
    COALESCE(r.space_id, r.room_full_name, r.room) AS space_name,
    r.area
  FROM rooms_with_building r
  WHERE (
    r.building_name_long ILIKE '%stata%'
    OR r.building_number = '32'
  )
    AND (r.use_desc IS NULL OR r.use_desc NOT ILIKE '%storage%')
),
-- Detail rows at (access_level, use_desc, space_name)
detail AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    0 AS level_order
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, use_desc, space_name
),
-- Subtotal per (access_level, use_desc)
sub_use AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    'Subtotal (Access Level, Usage Type)' AS space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    1 AS level_order
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, use_desc
),
-- Subtotal per access_level only
sub_access AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    'Subtotal (Access Level)' AS use_desc,
    'Subtotal (Access Level)' AS space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    2 AS level_order
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level
),
-- Grand total
grand AS (
  SELECT 
    NULL AS access_level,
    'Grand Total' AS use_desc,
    'Grand Total' AS space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    3 AS level_order
  FROM base
),
-- Union all tiers
unioned AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT access_level, use_desc, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area, level_order FROM sub_use
  UNION ALL
  SELECT access_level, use_desc, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area, level_order FROM sub_access
  UNION ALL
  SELECT access_level, use_desc, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area, level_order FROM grand
),
-- Order rows and blank out repeated access level to only show when it changes
ordered AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    space_name,
    num_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    level_order,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(access_level, 1e9), level_order, use_desc, space_name) AS rn,
    COALESCE(access_level, 1e9) AS access_sort
  FROM unioned
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    o.*,
    LAG(access_sort) OVER (ORDER BY access_sort, level_order, use_desc, space_name) AS prev_access_sort
  FROM ordered o
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN prev_access_sort IS DISTINCT FROM access_sort THEN CAST(access_level AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS access_level,
  use_desc AS usage_type,
  space_name,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(num_spaces) AS BIGINT)) AS number_of_spaces,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area_sqft,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(avg_area) AS BIGINT)) AS average_area_sqft
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY access_sort, level_order, usage_type, space_name;

# Final report: detail + subtotals by access level and usage type for Stata (bldg 32), exclude STORAGE; show access level only on change
sql = """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    r.access_level,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.use_desc), ''), 'Unspecified') AS use_desc,
    COALESCE(r.space_id, r.room_full_name, r.room) AS space_name,
    r.area
  FROM rooms_with_building r
  WHERE (
    r.building_name_long ILIKE '%stata%'
    OR r.building_number = '32'
  )
    AND (r.use_desc IS NULL OR r.use_desc NOT ILIKE '%storage%')
),
-- Detail rows (space-level)
detail AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    0 AS level_order
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, use_desc, space_name
),
-- Subtotal per (access_level, use_desc)
sub_use AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    'Subtotal (Access Level, Usage Type)' AS space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    1 AS level_order
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level, use_desc
),
-- Subtotal per access_level only
sub_access AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    'Subtotal (Access Level)' AS use_desc,
    'Subtotal (Access Level)' AS space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    2 AS level_order
  FROM base
  GROUP BY access_level
),
-- Grand total
grand AS (
  SELECT 
    NULL AS access_level,
    'Grand Total' AS use_desc,
    'Grand Total' AS space_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_spaces,
    SUM(area) AS total_area,
    AVG(area) AS avg_area,
    3 AS level_order
  FROM base
),
unioned AS (
  SELECT * FROM detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT access_level, use_desc, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area, level_order FROM sub_use
  UNION ALL
  SELECT access_level, use_desc, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area, level_order FROM sub_access
  UNION ALL
  SELECT access_level, use_desc, space_name, num_spaces, total_area, avg_area, level_order FROM grand
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT 
    access_level,
    use_desc,
    space_name,
    num_spaces,
    total_area,
    avg_area,
    level_order,
    COALESCE(access_level, 2147483647) AS access_sort
  FROM unioned
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    o.*,
    LAG(access_sort) OVER (ORDER BY access_sort, use_desc, level_order, space_name) AS prev_access_sort
  FROM ordered o
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN prev_access_sort IS DISTINCT FROM access_sort THEN CAST(access_level AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS access_level,
  use_desc AS usage_type,
  space_name,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(num_spaces) AS BIGINT)) AS number_of_spaces,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(total_area) AS BIGINT)) AS total_area_sqft,
  printf('%,d', CAST(ROUND(avg_area) AS BIGINT)) AS average_area_sqft
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY access_sort, use_desc, level_order, space_name;
"""
